verdict.rationale: Figma ships a natural-language 'Figma agent' for generating designs, diagrams, images, and file search (figma-docs-17, figma-docs-51, figma-docs-34), plus prompt-driven FigJam diagram generation (figma-docs-6/42) and an MCP server for NL-driven design/code workflows. However, community hands-on feedback specifically flags FigJam's AI tools as 'really bad and often broken' (figma-comm-8), undercutting reliability claims. Missing for 10: independent corroboration that the core Figma-agent (not just FigJam AI) reliably executes broad natural-language commands, and clearer documentation of command scope/limits.
